title.zh: 将南甘马粦省蒂高恩市镇塔洛洪贡描笼涯Salvacion国立中学的名称变更为Dr. Rodolfo V. Pamor，Jr.纪念国立中学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Salvacion National High School in Barangay Talojongon, Municipality of Tigaon, Province of Camarines Sur to the Dr. Rodolfo V. Pamor, Jr. Memorial National High School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Salvacion National High School in Barangay Talojongon, Municipality of Tigaon, Province of Camarines Sur to the Dr. Rodolfo V. Pamor, Jr. Memorial National High School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia Salvacion tại Barangay Talojongon, Thị trấn Tigaon, Tỉnh Camarines Sur thành Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia Dr. Rodolfo V. Pamor, Jr. Memorial
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ Salvacion ในบารังไกย์ Talojongon, เทศบาล Tigaon, จังหวัด Camarines Sur เป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ Dr. Rodolfo V. Pamor, Jr. Memorial
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional Salvacion di Barangay Talojongon, Kotamadya Tigaon, Provinsi Camarines Sur menjadi Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional Dr. Rodolfo V. Pamor, Jr. Memorial
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan Salvacion di Barangay Talojongon, Perbandaran Tigaon, Wilayah Camarines Sur menjadi Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan Dr. Rodolfo V. Pamor, Jr. Memorial

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2007/ra_9454_2007.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Renaming of National High School. - The Salvacion National High School in Barangay Talojongon, Municipality of Tigaon, Province of Camarines Sur is hereby changed to Dr. Rodolfo V. Pamor, Jr. Memorial National High School.
Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
